chunks: Do not eat the catfish, nor the eel, nor the zimmir, nor the floating one, which is that which dies in the water and then floats on the surface of the water.

key_terms.الزِّمِّيرَ: zimmir; a named aquatic creature forbidden in this ruling
key_terms.الطَّافِيَ: that which floats; specifically an animal that dies in the water and rises to the surface
key_terms.الْجِرِّيَّ: catfish; a type of fish prohibited to eat in this narration
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water; the setting in which the animal dies and floats
key_terms.الْمَارْمَاهِيَ: eel; an aquatic creature prohibited in this context

ai.seo_question: Which sea creatures did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام forbid eating?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام gives a legal ruling forbidding the eating of certain aquatic creatures, including those that die in the water and float to the surface. It reflects the fiqh distinction between permissible and impermissible seafood in Shia jurisprudence.
